opening.argument: The recording directly instructs viewers how to obtain the PlusToken application, stating that "this video will show you how to download plus the token" and explaining that they can download and install it on their phone. The accompanying description presents the multi-currency wallet as one that "still makes a profit," then directs viewers to an external site and provides a referral number. Together, these details go beyond a general discussion: they promote a token-related application through a profit-oriented representation and give viewers the practical means to access it and participate. The browser display of the Plus Token page and APK download confirmation further confirms that the promotion is operational and directed toward installation.
